interface.signature: S: str, R: int, N: int -> str

preconditions.description: The length of the binary string S must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of iterations R must be between 1 and 20.
The index N must be a valid index within the bounds of the final string length after R iterations.

postconditions.description: The output must be either '0' or '1', representing the Nth character of the transformed string.
